identification: Royal Australian Mint $200 gold Koala coin, 22ct (.916), 10 g, 24 mm, about 9.17 g fine gold, uncirculated issue in blue RAM vinyl wallet with card (not proof). Catalogued as 1983; the last digit of the date is not sharp in the photo and the card wording ('The Koala Bear is one of the best known...') differs from lot 955's 1983 card ('The Koala is one of...'), so it may be a 1980 or other early-1980s issue. Value is much the same either way.

viewing_check: Read the date (1980 vs 1983) under a loupe. Check surfaces for marks, fingerprints, toning; wallet and card intact. Weigh (10.0g) and check edge reeding to rule out a plated copy.
